title: DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated October 29, 2026, relative to the request for approval of a
text:
[3. CONSENT AGENDA ITEMS]
DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated October 29, 2026, relative to the request for approval of a
  Professional Services Agreement between the City of Los Angeles and Bode Cellmark Forensics, Inc.,
  for Forensic Services, as set forth.  [BPC #26-351]

  Recommendation(s) for Board action:

  APPROVE the Department’s report and TRANSMIT to the Mayor.
summary: The Police Commission is asked to approve a professional services agreement between the city and Bode Cellmark Forensics, Inc. for forensic services for the LAPD.
